fields.name: air_carrier_name
fields.description: Operating covered carrier.

fields.name: marketing_carrier_name
fields.description: Marketing carrier when different from the operating carrier.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Flight number experiencing the delay.

fields.name: origin_airport_code
fields.description: Originally scheduled origin airport.

fields.name: destination_airport_code
fields.description: Originally scheduled destination airport.

fields.name: tarmac_delay_airport_code
fields.description: U.S. airport at which the delay occurred.

fields.name: tarmac_delay_domestic
fields.description: Whether the affected flight is domestic for the applicable deplaning threshold.

fields.name: tarmac_delay_start_at
fields.description: Timestamp at which the tarmac delay began.

fields.name: tarmac_delay_end_at
fields.description: Timestamp at which the delay ended.

fields.name: tarmac_delay_minutes
fields.description: Elapsed tarmac-delay duration.

fields.name: deplane_opportunity_at
fields.description: Timestamp when passengers were offered an opportunity to deplane.

fields.name: deplane_exception_type
fields.description: Safety, security, or air-traffic-control exception relied upon.

fields.name: deplane_exception_authority
fields.description: Pilot-in-command or air-traffic-control record supporting the exception.

fields.name: food_water_provided_at
fields.description: Timestamp when adequate food and potable water were provided.

fields.name: lavatory_operable
fields.description: Whether required lavatory facilities remained operable.

fields.name: medical_attention_available
fields.description: Whether adequate medical attention was available if needed.

fields.name: delay_notification_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the passenger delay-status notification.

fields.name: passenger_notification_summary
fields.description: Summary of delay and deplaning notifications given to passengers.

fields.name: incident_resolution
fields.description: How the tarmac delay was resolved.

fields.name: reporting_deadline
fields.description: Deadline for the written DOT report when the reporting threshold is exceeded.

fields.name: regulator_name
fields.description: DOT Office of Aviation Consumer Protection or other recipient.

fields.name: regulation_citations
fields.description: Applicable citations including 14 CFR 259.4.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Time-sensitive care, deplaning, and reporting status with exceptions separated.
